name: L3VEL3 Black Gel 250ml

description: Maximum hold hair gel engineered for styles that demand absolute control. Super Strong delivers an unbreakable hold that keeps even the most challenging hair locked in place all day. The clear formula dries without flaking and washes out cleanly. Available in: 250ml · 500ml · 1000ml.

name: L3VEL3 Creamy Gel

name: Immortal NYC Strawberry Hair Wax 50ml
description: Compact styling wax with a medium hold (6/9) and a fresh strawberry fragrance. The formula repels moisture so the look stays impeccable even after a gym session or a day at the beach. Leaves no residue, washes out easily, and is suitable for daily use on all hair types.

name: Immortal NYC Matte Look Hair Wax 50ml
description: Clay-infused hair wax with a firm hold (7/9) and a dry matte finish. Adds volume and structure without stiffening the hair, delivering clean, contemporary styles with a natural appearance. Washes out easily and is ideal for daily professional use.

name: Immortal NYC Iconic Man Cream Pomade 50ml
description: Cream pomade engineered for perfect hold and natural brightness. The moisture-repelling formula keeps styles looking sharp through a gym workout or a day outdoors. Compact 50ml format is ideal for retail display and client take-home.

name: Immortal NYC Black Hair Styling Wax 100ml
description: Water-based styling wax with a strong matte hold. The easy-to-clean formula is versatile across all hair types — straight, wavy, or curly — delivering professional-quality styles from classic to contemporary. Washes out effortlessly with water.

name: Immortal NYC Chaos Sea Salt Pomade 100ml
description: Formulated with natural sea salt minerals, Chaos Sea Salt Pomade is designed to achieve the perfect messy beach style. Thickens hair strands by adding fullness and texture, providing extraordinary hold with a natural matte appearance on all hair types.

name: Immortal NYC Cream Sleek Styling Gel 100ml
description: Concentrated gel-wax formula with a strong hold that protects hair against moisture for an extended time. Creates great texture and enables precise styling while maintaining a sleek, polished finish without weighing the hair down.

name: Immortal NYC Creative Fiber Expert Wax 100ml
description: Extreme-hold fiber wax that thickens, texturizes, and adds fullness to hair. The fiber complex provides a strong, pliable hold with a matte finish and a natural fragrance. Ideal for creating structured, voluminous styles with visible texture and definition.

name: Immortal NYC Grease Original Pomade 100ml
description: The clay formula of Immortal NYC's Original Pomade delivers a strong hold with a high-shine finish for extraordinary styling results. Great texture and brilliant appearance across all looks, from retro pompadours to modern slick-backs.

name: Immortal NYC Captain Black Hair Styling Wax 100ml
description: Enriched with an argan & keratin complex for a flexible, lightweight hold that protects hair against moisture long-term. Creates great texture and enables precise application of fashion styles without making the hair heavy.

name: Immortal NYC One in a Million Hair Wax 100ml
description: Flexible hold wax (8/9) with no damaging effects on hair. Adds massive texture and resists the effects of humidity, allowing creation of a wide range of styles that last. Suitable for daily professional use on all hair types.

name: Immortal NYC Venom Super Wax 100ml
description: High-performance styling wax with a glossy finish and extreme hold. Venom Super Wax delivers intense shine with a powerful grip that keeps every strand locked in place all day. The rich formula glides smoothly and distributes evenly through the hair without clumping.

name: Immortal NYC Wild West Super Natural Wax 100ml
description: Natural-look styling wax with a super-natural matte finish. Wild West creates effortless, lived-in styles with flexible hold that lets hair move naturally while maintaining shape. Ideal for textured crops, messy quiffs, and relaxed modern looks.

name: Immortal NYC Samurai Spirit Super Matte Wax 100ml
description: Ultra-matte styling wax with a strong hold inspired by the precision of the samurai. Samurai Spirit delivers a completely shine-free, dry finish with serious staying power. The thick formula provides maximum control for sharp, structured styles that last from morning to night.

name: Immortal NYC Brilliante Glossy Pomade 100ml
description: Premium glossy pomade that delivers a brilliant, mirror-like shine with a strong, lasting hold. Brilliante is formulated for barbers who demand the highest level of gloss and definition. Creates sleek, polished styles from classic pompadours to modern slick-backs with a wet-look finish.

name: Immortal NYC Master Clay Pomade 100ml
description: Professional clay pomade with a firm hold (7/9) and a natural matte finish. Master Clay combines kaolin clay with conditioning agents to provide strong control without drying the hair. Ideal for textured, voluminous styles with a clean, dry appearance.

name: Immortal NYC Matte Tobacco Pomade 100ml
description: A distinctive matte pomade infused with a warm tobacco fragrance. Delivers a strong, lasting hold with a completely matte, dry finish. The refined scent sets it apart — subtle tobacco notes that add a masculine, sophisticated edge to every styling session.

name: Immortal NYC The Creed Classic Pomade 100ml
description: A signature pomade from Immortal NYC's premium range. The Creed Classic delivers a strong, refined hold with a balanced shine that works across all hair types. Inspired by timeless barbering tradition, this pomade provides exceptional styling versatility with a distinguished, long-lasting fragrance.

name: Immortal NYC Deluxe Super Pomade 100ml
description: Maximum hold pomade (9/9) designed for the most demanding styles. Deluxe Super Pomade locks hair firmly in place all day with a medium shine finish. Built for voluminous pompadours, sharp side-parts, and any style that requires uncompromising hold under all conditions.

name: Glemen Vitality Glossy Hair Wax 150ml
description: High-shine professional hair wax from Glemen that provides a strong, long-lasting hold. Creates and maintains any desired style — from smooth, controlled looks to structured volume-rich shapes. A versatile barbershop wax built to perform all day.

name: Glemen Damas Styling Powder 20g
description: Premium volume styling powder engineered to the highest standards. Instantly adds body and texture with a clean matte finish. A single application transforms flat hair into a lifted, voluminous style. Essential for textured and modern barbershop looks.

name: Glemen Breeze Aftershave Cologne — Bergamot & Mint 200ml
description: Invigorating aftershave cologne infused with bergamot and mint. The unique formula combines the beneficial properties of bergamot with the freshness of mint, creating a refreshing and cooling sensation that soothes the skin after shaving or a haircut. Ideal for clients who prefer a fresh, light scent.

name: Glemen Imperial Aftershave Cologne — Black Pepper 200ml
description: A distinguished aftershave cologne with intense black pepper notes and warm woody accords — the choice for the modern man who values elegance and refinement. Black pepper's antimicrobial properties (piperine) help prevent minor irritations after shaving, while delivering a bold and masculine fragrance.

name: Glemen Obsidia A5 Aftershave Cologne — Spiced Caramel & Vanilla 400ml
description: Premium aftershave cologne that transforms the post-shave routine into a luxurious experience. The sophisticated formula pairs the calming effect of a modern aftershave with warm, spiced caramel and vanilla notes. Absorbs quickly, reducing irritation, redness, and dryness after shaving.

name: Glemen Raven A3 Aftershave Cologne — Strawberry & Vanilla 400ml
description: Elegant aftershave cologne with a sophisticated strawberry and vanilla aroma. The light-textured formula absorbs rapidly, providing freshness, hydration, and protection after every shave. Reduces redness and dryness while leaving a long-lasting, distinctive scent.

name: Glemen Zafir A4 Aftershave Cologne — Honey Caramel & Vanilla 400ml
description: A premium aftershave experience combining sweet honey caramel and vanilla notes for a warm, indulgent finish to any shave service. The fast-absorbing formula soothes freshly shaved skin, eliminating redness and discomfort while leaving a memorable fragrance.

name: Glemen Liberty Professional Hairspray 750ml
description: Professional extra-strong finishing hairspray that locks any hairstyle firmly in place. Delivers a long-lasting hold without stiffening or leaving residue. The versatile formula suits all hair types and is ideal for barbershops requiring a reliable finishing spray for every service.

name: Glemen Legion Salt Spray 300ml
description: Texture and volume salt spray that delivers a natural beach-wave effect with a matte finish. Adds body, grip, and anti-static control to the hair. Perfect for creating effortless tousled, modern styles — from relaxed waves to structured messy looks.

name: Glemen Iceberg Menthol Hair Tonic 400ml
description: Cooling menthol-infused hair tonic that revitalises the scalp and hair after every cut or shave. The refreshing formula calms and soothes the scalp instantly on contact. Excellent for use during scalp massages, adding a professional finishing touch to every barbershop service.

name: Glemen Renegade Wax Spray 300ml
description: Innovative spray wax that combines the pliable hold of a wax with the easy application of a spray. Provides flexible hold and texture without the heaviness of traditional wax. Ideal for adding definition, movement, and light control to any style.

description: Professional barbershop shampoo formulated to deeply cleanse the scalp and hair while maintaining moisture balance. Suitable for all hair types, the Engage shampoo is ideal for in-salon use — removing product build-up effectively while leaving hair soft, healthy, and manageable.

name: Glemen Adventure Beard Balm 150ml

A reliable choice for barbershops requiring dependable blade performance at professional volume.

name: ARD AL Zaafaran Hayaati Exotic
description: Hayaati Exotic by Ard Al Zaafaran is a newly released (2025) Eau de Parfum designed for women. It is a vibrant, fruity-gourmand fragrance known for its "edible" and juicy scent profile. Fragrance Breakdown Top Notes: Apple, Sicilian Bergamot, Italian Lemon, and Star Anise.

name: ARD AL Zaafaran Jazaab Gold
description: Fragrance Profile Top Notes Middle Notes Base Notes Cedar, Citrus, Rose Oud, Pink Pepper, Grapefruit Oud, Amber, Cedar, Patchouli Scent & Experience Reviewers praise Jazaab Gold for its sophisticated blend that balances freshness with depth.

name: ARD AL Zaafaran Jazzab Silver
description: Ard Al Zaafaran Jazzab Silver is a cool, masculine aromatic woody fragrance ideal for daily wear and warm weather. It features a refreshing citrus opening, subtle spices, and a clean, woody base—making it a reliable and versatile choice for men who enjoy fresh yet refined scents.

name: Fariis Riwayah Amalfi
description: Fariis Riwayah Amalfi is a unisex Eau de Parfum (100ml) known for its fresh, woody, and smoky profile. It is widely recognized as an affordable alternative or "dupe" inspired by the popular fragrance Gissah Capri .

name: Fariis Riwayah Imperial
description: FARIIS Riwayah Imperial is an Extrait de Parfum that has gained popularity as an affordable alternative (dupe) of the fragrance Imperial Valley by the house of Gissah .

name: Fariis Riwayah Lunara
description: Fariis Riwayah Lunara is a popular unisex Eau de Parfum known for being a high-quality alternative (dupe) to La Luna by Gissah . Fragrance Profile: It is a rich, oriental scent characterized by a mix of fruity and smoky notes: Top Notes: Sweet Raspberry.

name: Fariis Riwayah THE Only ONE
description: Fariis Riwayah The Only One is a unisex fragrance (Eau de Parfum) from the Fariis collection. It is widely recognized as a high-quality alternative to the popular One & Only by Gissah .

name: Fariis Rose Melody
description: Rose Melody by FARiiS is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Layer Notes Top Notes Red Mandarin, Nectar, Peach Middle (Heart) Notes White Flowers, Vanilla Sugar, Jasmine Base Notes Maple Syrup, Amber Structure overview: Opening: Bright citrus and juicy fruit sweetness.

name: Fragrance World Just Anabi
description: Fragrance World Just Anabi is a luxurious and complex unisex Eau de Parfum, known for its rich blend of fruity, spicy, and smoky notes with a distinct cherry and leather .

name: Fragrance World Just Lychee
description: "Just Lychee" refers to Fragrance World Just Lychee , a popular woman's Eau de Parfum perfume, known for its sweet, tropical and fruity scent profile with gourmand accents.

name: Fragrance World Just Wardi
description: Just Wardi by Fragrance World is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women . Just Wardi was launched in 2023. Top notes are Coconut, Mandarin and Peach . Middle notes are Sweet Notes, Ylang Ylang, White Flowers and Rose. Base notes are Vanilla, Caramel, Musk, Amber and Cedarwood.

name: French Avenue Royal Blend
description: FA Royal Blend is a unisex Eau de Parfum by French Avenue , celebrated for its warm, sophisticated, and luxurious aroma.

name: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Amethyst
description: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Amethyst is a rich, warm unisex Amber Vanilla fragrance with a luxurious blend of spicy, floral, and woody notes. It opens with bright pink pepper and fresh bergamot, followed by a floral heart of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, and jasmine.

name: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Honor & Glory
description: Lattafa badee al oud Honor & Glory Eau de Parfum is known for its unique opening that blends fruity tropical freshness with creamy sweetness, followed by a warm, spicy heart and a rich, woody base.

name: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Nuble Blush

name: Lattafa Khamrah

description: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa is a rich and decadent amber gourmand fragrance that takes the beloved DNA of the original Khamrah and deepens it with a bold, aromatic coffee note.

description: Lattafa Opulent Dubai is a vibrant and luxurious woody fruity fragrance for men and women, known for its juicy mango and citrus opening that transitions into a sophisticated, warm, and woody dry-down.

name: Lattafa Qaed AL Fursan Untamed
description: Lattafa Qaed Al Fursan Untamed is a bold and intense amber spicy fragrance, known for its powerful blend of warm spices, sweet caramel, and rich smoky woods. Designed as a unisex scent, it delivers depth, complexity, and exceptional longevity.

name: Lattafa Yara
description: Lattafa Yara is an amber vanilla fragrance for women, celebrated for its sweet, creamy, and feminine character. It opens with a soft blend of tangerine , orchid , and heliotrope , moving into a delicious heart of tropical fruits and gourmand accords .
